trademarks.heading: Trademarks
trademarks.disclaimer: d20 Folio is an independent companion for Dungeons & Dragons 2024. It is not affiliated with, endorsed, sponsored by, or created by Wizards of the Coast. Dungeons & Dragons, D&D, and their logos are trademarks of Wizards of the Coast LLC.
trademarks.body: That reference is nominative: it is made only to describe what d20 Folio is for and what it is compatible with, never to imply any official status. Those trademarks are not licensed by the SRD, and d20 Folio uses no D&D or Wizards of the Coast logos, artwork, or trade dress.
trademarks.compatible: As the SRD license terms allow, d20 Folio is compatible with fifth edition; its rules content comes from the System Reference Documents (see Attribution above).

app.heading: The App
app.body: d20 Folio is a free, bilingual, unofficial fan companion for playing Dungeons & Dragons 2024 characters. It is built for a home table and is not approved or endorsed by Wizards of the Coast.
app.editions: Rules content follows the D&D 2024 SRD by default; other editions and homebrew are supported through custom overrides.

privacy.heading: Privacy Policy
privacy.effective: Effective 2 August 2026 · Data controller: Salvatore Di Cara · salvodicara@gmail.com
privacy.intro: d20 Folio collects the minimum it needs to run, and nothing more. No analytics, no advertising, no trackers: your data exists so your table can play.
privacy.collectD: Your Google account profile when you sign in (name, email address, avatar) and the content you create: characters, campaigns, notes, portraits, and any bug reports you send. Firebase Authentication keeps your sign-in state in your browser's local storage; there are no advertising or analytics cookies.
privacy.useD: To provide the service you asked for: storing your characters, syncing them across your devices, and running the campaign features you join (legal basis: performance of a contract). Abuse prevention and account blocking rest on our legitimate interest in keeping the service safe.
privacy.whereD: On Google Firebase (Firestore, Cloud Storage, Authentication), region europe-west1 (Belgium). Google acts as our processor under its Data Processing Terms, with EU Standard Contractual Clauses where transfers apply.
privacy.sharingT: What is shared, and with whom
privacy.sharingD: Only what you choose to share with other players: joining a campaign shows your shared characters and notes to that table, and a share link you enable makes a character readable by anyone with the URL until you revoke it. Two operational flows reach outside services: sending an in-app bug report opens an issue on our GitHub tracker (so include only what you're comfortable posting there), and your first sign-in sends the site owner a short new-user notice by email. We never sell your data or hand it to advertisers.
privacy.retentionD: Until you delete it. You can delete characters and campaigns yourself at any time; to erase your whole account, ask us (in-app report or email) and the account with everything it owns (characters, portraits, campaign membership) is removed.
privacy.rightsD: Access, rectification, erasure, restriction, portability (every character exports as JSON in one tap), and objection: write to the address above. You may also lodge a complaint with your supervisory authority (in Italy, the Garante per la Protezione dei Dati Personali).
privacy.childrenD: d20 Folio is not directed at children under 14, the age of digital consent in Italy.
privacy.changesD: If this policy changes, the new text is posted here with a new effective date.

terms.heading: Terms of Use
terms.intro: The short version: d20 Folio is free, your content is yours, and the table deserves fair play.
terms.serviceD: d20 Folio is a free companion app for fifth-edition play, offered as-is and as-available, without warranties of any kind. It is in active development: features may change and availability is not guaranteed.
terms.contentD: Characters, campaigns, notes, and portraits you create remain yours. You grant us only the technical license needed to store them and to show them to you and to the people you choose to share them with.
terms.conductD: Don't upload unlawful content, don't abuse shared spaces, don't attack the service. Accounts that do may be blocked or removed.
terms.unofficialD: d20 Folio is unofficial fan content, not affiliated with, approved, or endorsed by Wizards of the Coast. Dungeons & Dragons and D&D are trademarks of Wizards of the Coast LLC. Rules content is reproduced from the SRD 5.2.1 and 5.1 under CC-BY-4.0 (see Attribution above).
terms.liabilityD: To the extent the law allows, we are not liable for damages arising from the use of a free service. Keep local JSON exports of anything you care about.
terms.lawD: These terms are governed by Italian law; any mandatory consumer protections of your country of residence remain unaffected.
